title: Introductory Statistics for CRFS
description: A rigorous yet accessible introduction to applied statistics for undergraduate level and beyond, emphasising practical applications and real data. Designed to build statistical thinking without requiring advanced mathematics. This variant is adapted for CRFS: the examples and context have been changed to fit CRFS work in Africa and the Sahel.
authors: Original by David M. Diez, Christopher D. Barr, Mine Cetinkaya-Rundel; this variant is for CRFS
subject: general
